description: Attio is a data-driven CRM with customizable objects and a REST API for records, lists, and workspace data.
access_notes: A single-workspace API key can be generated manually and used immediately; OAuth2 is available for multi-workspace apps. No sign-up gate found beyond having an Attio workspace.
api_notes: Covers records, lists, objects/attributes, notes, and workspace members -- a real but narrower surface than the larger legacy CRMs.
